subject: (Apparent) changes in optimization algorithm used by `lavaan`

messages.author: 23a4293d4c2373b0
messages.subject: (Apparent) changes in optimization algorithm used by `lavaan`
parts:
Hi! This request for help is a copy of a question I posted to Stackoverflow, where I was redirected to this list.

NOTE: ALL FILES TO REPRODUCE THE EXAMPLE CAN BE DOWNLOADED HERE

I have come back to working on a project after several months. I was working previously with lavaan version 0.6-5, but when I came back I tried to update to the latest, which by now is 0.6-11.

The model I'm trying to fit is rather complex, so (although I'm not sure it's necessary to make my point) for the sake of clarity I'm including the path diagram:


It is worth stating that all observable variables are categorical except c3, which is a (standardized) continuous variable (parameter C2 =~ c3 is set to 1 for identification). In the following you can see the reprex and its output for version 0.6-5 (please note it's NOT a truly rendered reprex, as it gave an error when trying to load the dataset; instead, I pasted and formatted the output manually):
library(lavaan)
## This is lavaan 0.6-5
## lavaan is BETA software! Please report any bugs.

load("dataset.Rdata")

lavaan_spec <- "
  S1 =~ sp1 + sp2 + sp4 +
        sp5 + sp6 + sp8 +
        sp3 + sp7
  S2 =~ sp5 + sp6 + sp8
  S3 =~ sp8 + sp3 + sp7

  C1 =~ c1 + c2 + S1

  C2 =~ 1*c3
  C2 ~~ C1
"

lavaan_fit <- dataset |> lavaan(
  model = lavaan_spec,
  std.lv = TRUE,
  missing = "pairwise",
  estimator = "default"
)

Now, the problem is that when I tried it with the updated version of the package, I haven't been able to reproduce the same results, which seems to be due to the parameters related to observable variable sp7 not properly converging; at least that is what seems to happen when one compares the fit statistics among the different versions. However, lavaan says that the model converges normally. I have tried reproducing the reprex with the different versions from 0.6-5 to 0.6-11, and gather the results for fit indices and the parameters related to sp7 (this output omits the model summary above, for conciseness):

test_version <- function(version) {

  renv::use(paste0("lavaan@", version))

  source("lavaan_test.R", encoding = 'UTF-8')

  estimates <- lavaan_fit |> parameterestimates()
  select_est <- estimates[
    estimates$lhs %in% c("sp7", "S3") &
      estimates$rhs == "sp7" &
      estimates$op != "~*~",
  ]
  param_est <- select_est$est
  names(param_est) <- paste(select_est$lhs, select_est$rhs,sep = '.')

  list(
    version = version,
    iterations = lavaan_fit |> lavInspect("iterations"),
    converged = lavaan_fit |> lavInspect("converged")
  ) |>
    append(fitmeasures(lavaan_fit, c("chisq", "chisq.scaled"))) |>
    append(param_est) |>
    as.data.frame()
}

lavaan_versions <- paste0("0.6-", 5:11)

result <- data.frame()

for (version in lavaan_versions) {

  result <- result |> rbind(
    xfun::Rscript_call(
      test_version, list(version = version)
    )
  )
}

As can be seen in this output:

  1. All versions give a TRUE convergence value.
  2. Only version 0.6-5 seems to truly find the absolute minimum (although it's possible that there was something wrong in this version that has been corrected?)
  3. Version 0.6-6 and 0.6-7, although don't find the absolute minimum, give very similar values for the estimates of the parameters in conflict (but 0.6-7 is clearly far from the absolute minimum).
  4. Only version 0.6-6 "warns" that the polyserial correlation of c3 with the sp variables has not converged (although the polyserial correlation values don't seem weird, see below).
  5. Version 0.6-7 warns of a poliserial correlation close to 1.0 (which doesn't seem to be, see below).
  6. From version 0.6-8 on, the result is stable, with a warning about the negative covariances.

messages.subject: Re: (Apparent) changes in optimization algorithm used by `lavaan`
parts: I was working previously with lavaan version 0.6-5, but when I came back I tried to update to the latest, which by now is 0.6-11

Take a look at the version history:

https://lavaan.ugent.be/history/dot6.html

In particular, the changes in 0.6-7 may yield different results if it was necessary to re-run your model for the reasons listed there.
